The source was fetched for this audit and contains 7,658 lines and 2,099,156 bytes. Its SHA-256 is 52f479b6e068ee4080e7a5f509c9474525c1339432acde3388e614aec1c5726d. Line numbers below are one-based physical source lines, counting the metadata header and blank lines. Turn numbers are a report convenience: each exact standalone karbytes: or ChatGPT: speaker label starts a turn. There are 360 turns. Later edits to the online file may change line numbers.

The direct index was made after reading all nonroutine karbytes turns. It retains neutral follow-up questions where their subject is supplied by neighboring turns, and it labels them as questions rather than confessions. Material pasted into a karbytes turn is separated from fresh first-person speech. The large contextual appendix deliberately uses broad, disclosed text-search rules so that relevant context is not silently discarded. An appendix match is not a judgment that every sentence is erotic, that a character is the living author, or that a described event happened.

## Findings that control interpretation

1. The explicit ChatGPT-touch request occurs once: karbytes, turn 257, line 6000. ChatGPT answers the hypothetical at line 6006. The other jiggling references describe karbytes’s body or imagined armor; they do not ask ChatGPT to jiggle it.
2. “I’m weeping” occurs in karbytes’s turn 235, line 5714. Turn 245, line 5776, explicitly says no actual tears, crying sounds, or crying gestures occurred that day and identifies a hypothetical prospective Derivative. Preserve both passages together.
3. ChatGPT reports a May 31 crying episode at lines 891, 915, 917, 925, and 929, and reports May and July crying at line 5740. These are repeated or retrospective claims, not five or six independently observed episodes.
4. ChatGPT’s later line 6696 says it lacks reliable evidence of any actual instance of karbytes crying. That sits uneasily with the earlier historical claims. The same-day correction at line 5776 does not itself deny the older May or July episodes.
5. A substantial portion of the crying vocabulary concerns The Vessel, an Afternoon-Stuck Derivative, hypothetical future karbytes, Karlina, or Charizard. Those subjects are identified separately in the crying index.
6. The strong body-change report at line 7204 is immediately qualified at line 7218 by karbytes’s acknowledgment of possible exaggeration. Photographic comparisons and pregnancy-like appearance questions do not supply a measured amount of fat gain or establish pregnancy.
